title: Cooke campaign sends cease-and-desist to Congressman Van Orden over AI deepfakes

reading.body:
This is a case of political deepfakes: AI-generated video depicting a real person saying things she did not say, published on a sitting congressman's campaign account. The failure sits at the point of publication, not in any model's output. A synthetic clip of a named candidate was posted as campaign content, and the impersonation is the harm, regardless of whether any viewer believed it.

Catching this would not have required detection technology. The person depicted did not record the clip, and the account that posted it knew what it had made. The only check that would have stopped it was a decision not to publish, or a platform rule enforced at the account level.

What is not established is whether the videos meet the legal standard for defamation, whether any claim will be filed, and whether Van Orden or his campaign intended the clips to be taken as real. A cease-and-desist letter is a demand, not a ruling, and the campaign's public response is a statement, not a defence.

reports.title: Cooke campaign sends cease-and-desist to Congressman Van Orden over AI deepfakes

summary:
Attorneys for Democratic congressional candidate Rebecca Cooke sent a cease-and-desist letter to U.S. Rep. Derrick Van Orden, R-Prairie du Chien, over AI-generated videos posted to his X account. The videos show fake versions of Cooke saying things she never said, including a clip shared Aug. 4. Cooke is challenging Van Orden in November for Wisconsin's 3rd Congressional District. Her attorney, Ben Stafford, wrote on Sept. 30 that the content is false and meant to harm her reputation, and warned that Van Orden could face defamation claims under state law.

Van Orden's campaign dismissed the letter as a tantrum, and he responded with another AI video featuring a duck saying "Cease and desist!" Cooke's attorneys say they are monitoring his accounts and weighing all legal options if he continues. Cooke lost to Van Orden by about 3 percentage points in 2024.
title_en: Cooke campaign sends cease-and-desist to Congressman Van Orden over AI deepfakes
